description: Canonical egress grant, invocation token and policy vectors. Generated by `go test ./packages/egress -run TestVectors -update`; never edit by hand.
Times are Unix seconds; verify every token at `now`. Verifiers allow clockSkewSeconds on exp, nbf and iat.
Keys: seed is the base64url (no padding) 32-byte Ed25519 seed, publicKey the raw public key. keySet is the trust set in the egress-trust/runtime-trust format; untrusted keys are not in it.

Tokens: compact JWS, header {"alg":"EdDSA","typ":"JWT","kid":...}. For mintable vectors, signing base64url(headerJson) + '.' + base64url(claimsJson) with the signer's key must reproduce `token` byte for byte (Ed25519 is deterministic). `claims` equals claimsJson parsed; JSON.stringify(claims) === claimsJson.

Canonical claim order: grants iss, aud, jti, tenantId, functionId, effectiveFunctionId, functionVersionId, enclaveId, enclaveIdentifier, buildRunId, source, policy, allowAll, iat, nbf, exp; invocation tokens iss, aud, jti, functionVersionId, payloadSha256, iat, exp. Absent optional claims are omitted, never null.

Verification order (determines the error code): malformed (segments, base64url, JSON), unsupported_alg (alg != EdDSA), unknown_kid, bad_signature, malformed (claims not a JSON object), wrong_audience, missing_claims (iat or exp absent), expired (now > exp + skew), not_yet_valid (now + skew < nbf), issued_in_future (now + skew < iat), then per-token claims: missing_claims, invalid_policy.

Invocation vectors may carry payloadJson (check sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes against payloadSha256, expectPayload) and bindGrant (jti and functionVersionId must equal that grant's, expectBinding). "ok" means the check passes.

Policy cases: evaluate the destination (host is the hostname the address was resolved for, empty for IP literals) under configs[config] and grants[grant]. Reasons: allowed public|internal, denied policy|hard_deny|internal_disabled. Embedded IPv4 forms (::ffff:0:0/96, ::/96, 64:ff9b::/96, 2002::/16) are evaluated as both the IPv6 and the embedded IPv4 address, with the IPv6 form classified internal exactly when the embedded address is; the stricter verdict wins (hard_deny > internal_disabled > policy).

grants.name: function-grant-full
grants.description: Lambda function grant with every attribution claim, CIDR entries with and without port ranges, and host rules.

grants.name: function-grant-public-only
grants.description: Knative grant without policy (public internet only), without nbf.

grants.name: function-grant-allow-all
grants.description: allowAll grant.

grants.name: function-grant-empty-fallback
grants.description: Policy compiled from firewalls that allow nothing (compileNetworkAllowList empty fallback).

grants.name: build-grant
grants.description: Build grant signed by forge's key.

grants.name: explicit-kid
grants.description: Signed with a key whose kid is configured explicitly instead of derived.

grants.name: expired-within-skew
grants.description: exp = now - 30: still valid with 30 s skew.

grants.name: expired
grants.description: exp = now - 31.

grants.name: not-before-within-skew
grants.description: nbf = now + 30: valid with skew.

grants.name: not-yet-valid
grants.description: nbf = now + 31.

grants.name: issued-in-future
grants.description: iat = now + 31.

grants.name: wrong-audience
grants.description: aud is the invocation audience.

grants.name: audience-array
grants.description: aud as an array containing metorial-egress is accepted.

grants.name: unknown-kid
grants.description: Signed by a key that is not in the trust set.

grants.name: bad-signature-wrong-key
grants.description: Header names a trusted kid, signature made with the untrusted key.

grants.name: bad-signature-flipped
grants.description: Valid token with one signature byte changed.

grants.name: tampered-payload
grants.description: function-grant-public-only with allowAll added to the payload, original signature.

grants.name: alg-hs256
grants.description: alg HS256 (the deflector's format) is rejected before any key lookup.

grants.name: alg-none
grants.description: alg none with an empty signature.

grants.name: malformed-two-segments
grants.description: Only two segments.

grants.name: missing-exp
grants.description: No exp claim.

grants.name: missing-source
grants.description: No source claim.

grants.name: function-grant-missing-tenant
grants.description: Function grant without tenantId.

grants.name: build-grant-missing-run
grants.description: Build grant without buildRunId.

grants.name: invalid-policy-cidr
grants.description: Unparseable CIDR.

grants.name: invalid-policy-port-range
grants.description: Port range starting at 0.

grants.name: invalid-policy-host
grants.description: Host pattern with two wildcards.

grants.name: invocation-token-as-grant
grants.description: An invocation token presented as an egress grant.

invocationTokens.name: valid-ascii
invocationTokens.description: Valid token for an ASCII payload, bound to function-grant-full.

invocationTokens.name: valid-unicode
invocationTokens.description: Non-ASCII payloadJson (2-, 3- and 4-byte UTF-8): the hash covers the exact UTF-8 bytes.

invocationTokens.name: payload-escaped-spelling
invocationTokens.description: Same token as valid-unicode, presented with the \u-escaped spelling of the same JSON value: different bytes, so the hash doesn't match.

invocationTokens.name: binding-other-jti
invocationTokens.description: Token for another invocation paired with function-grant-full.

invocationTokens.name: binding-other-version
invocationTokens.description: Token for another version paired with function-grant-full.

invocationTokens.name: grant-as-invocation-token
invocationTokens.description: An egress grant presented as an invocation token.

invocationTokens.name: bad-signature
invocationTokens.description: Valid token with one signature byte changed.

invocationTokens.name: tampered-payload-hash
